diff --git a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
--- a/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
+++ b/django/db/models/fields/__init__.py
@@ -2517,8 +2517,24 @@
     """
 
     @property
+    @property
     def _subclasses(self):
-        return (BigAutoField, SmallAutoField)
+        """
+        Return a tuple of classes that should be considered subclasses of
+        AutoField. This includes BigAutoField, SmallAutoField, and any
+        subclasses of those classes. The list is computed lazily so that
+        the classes are already defined when the property is accessed.
+        """
+        subclasses = [BigAutoField, SmallAutoField]
+
+        def _collect(cls):
+            for sub in cls.__subclasses__():
+                subclasses.append(sub)
+                _collect(sub)
+
+        _collect(BigAutoField)
+        _collect(SmallAutoField)
+        return tuple(subclasses)
 
     def __instancecheck__(self, instance):
         return isinstance(instance, self._subclasses) or super().__instancecheck__(instance)
